title: A machine learning approach in the non-invasive prediction of intracranial pressure using Modified Photoplethysmography
summary: Machine learning applied to modified retinal photoplethysmography features estimated invasive-reference intracranial pressure in the study cohort; this is an early non-invasive measurement result with limited sample scope.
